snippet.title: Vanran - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Don't miss the Reveal Trailer for Vanran, a dark fantasy action RPG developed by Becuzus. Players will engage with a deep and stylish soulslike combat system through random dungeons on a journey ending with a multitude of different endings. Rise as a fallen slave destined to wield a blade to spark rebellion in Vanran, coming soon to PC (Steam).

#ign #gaming
